name: A possible household person duplicate requires manager confirmation
title: SC-08-02-03 A possible household person duplicate requires manager confirmation
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given the site already has a person with the same normalized phone or similar name
When a manager adds a different household member without confirming the match
Then the household change is rejected and the matching person candidates are returned
